title: Saparo
description_en: Muse for shopping with deals stacks. Saparo is a personal shopping agent that stacks every deal. Tell it what you want, and it searches U.S. stores for the same item in your size, combining promo codes, cash back, and eligible card offers that work together. It ranks options by estimated total cost, including shipping and tax, so you skip the legwork. With your approval, Saparo applies selected offers and gets checkout ready. You review the order and make the final payment yourself.

title: Tripmojo
description_en: Agentic travel app that helps plan, book and run your trip. Tripmojo syncs your booking emails into one shared trip, then Mojo, your AI travel agent, helps run it. Plan in a group chat where Mojo answers, runs polls and finds places. On travel day Mojo tries to check you in, saves your boarding pass, flags delays and gate changes, and tells you when to leave. On the trip it keeps today's plan current and splits expenses. Free on iOS and Android.

title: Docker
description_en: Built to run on trust, for the agentic era. Docker is evolving for the agentic era. Containers isolate workloads, but agents aren't workloads: they're actors that need isolation, security and governance. The new Docker brings a trusted supply chain for agents to build from, a trusted runtime to isolate them (Docker Sandboxes), and governance for agents across every team (Docker AI Governance), alongside a redesigned brand and Moby whale.

title: AlterContacts
description_en: AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead. AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry.

title: Bookella
description_en: A reading tracker that helps you read more. Bookella is a reading tracker and home library for iPhone, iPad and Android. Add books in seconds: search 122 million titles in 28 languages, pick from reading lists, scan a whole shelf of barcodes at once, or let AI pick your next book. Set yearly and daily reading goals, time your sessions, and track your reading pace. Keep notes and quotes, and see when and how much you read. You can also import from Goodreads, StoryGraph or CSV. No ads.

title: AI Context Flow MCP
description_en: Memory you control, synced to every agent, tool and team. Ten AI tools, ten partial memories, all drifting apart, with no record of who changed what. AI Context Flow fixes that with one shared memory over MCP. Save a client brief in Claude, and tomorrow your ChatGPT, Grok Bot and your teammate’s Cursor all work from the same version. Organize memory into buckets by project or client, choose who can access each one, and see every edit in full version history. If an agent overwrites something, roll it back.

title: Currents
description_en: Currents for Claude & Codex to see all your tests. Currents records every Playwright test run in CI. Now Claude and Codex can read it. Connect from the Claude or ChatGPT/Codex plugin directory, sign in, and ask why CI failed. Your agent gets the failure, its history and the trace. Automatically.

title: Codemany
description_en: Run GitHub Actions 3x faster. Run GitHub Actions on your own infra. Codemany orchestrates the runners: a fresh VM for each job. 3x faster, and NO per-minute bill. Our CI bill went from $215 in October to $4 so far in November. Free 14 days, no card.

title: Glassmail
description_en: A fast Mac email app with AI that never leaves your Mac. Most new email apps charge you every month and send your mail to their servers so their AI can read it. Glassmail doesn't. It's a native Mac app for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook and any IMAP account, and its AI runs on your Mac. Ask "what needs me today?" and get an answer. Type "yes, but next week" and get a reply in your own voice. Clear your inbox one key at a time. There's no mail server and no subscription. You pay once, and it's yours.

title: Tamekoshi
description_en: A Tamagotchi-style AI companion that does real work. Tame is an AI companion that does real work from the top of your screen: one message with three asks becomes three subagents in parallel, it runs tasks on its own computer, answers clients on WhatsApp and Telegram and writes meeting notes speaker by speaker. Nothing acts without your OK. Think Tamagotchi, all grown up. Free beta; a mobile app, multiplayer and open source are on the roadmap.

title: Volcano
description_en: The self-healing agent cloud by Kong. Volcano is one place to build, host and run agents and apps. Deploy from the coding agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi) or the AI Builder. You get year-long durable functions, human-in-the-loop approvals, resumable sandboxes, distributed locks, branchable Postgres, auth, storage, realtime, and backend and Next.js hosting. LavaFlow finds and fixes bugs on its own, so your apps and agents keep getting better over time.

title: tensorViz
description_en: Let your coding agent see inside your PyTorch model. Coding agents can read your PyTorch code, but they never see what actually flows through the model. tensorViz runs one real forward pass and turns it into an interactive graph with every module and tensor shape. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can search that graph and read the measured shapes, so they fix model code from evidence instead of guesses. Or skip the install: the Model Explorer has graphs of 560+ models from recent papers to browse and discuss. Free and open source (MIT).

title: OpenVorld
description_en: Give your AI agents a home you can see. OpenVorld is an open-source harness for AI agents, with a visible world on top. Every project is a pixel-art village, and every agent has a name, a role and a brain: Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. You watch the crew work, and they ask before they use a folder, a command or a website. Free, open source and local. No account needed.

title: Memanto Cloud
description_en: A companion memory for agents to improve as you work. A companion memory agent that lets your agents focus and improve while you keep ownership of everything they learn. Now hosted for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 31 more: sign in once, no Docker, no API key.

title: Rox
description_en: Your AI companion for living with chronic illness. Rox is an AI health companion for people living with chronic illness, including POTS, fibromyalgia, ME/CFS, MS, and long COVID. Track symptoms and medications, connect wearable health data, spot patterns, and prepare for doctor appointments in one place. Rox remembers your health context over time, so you can spend less energy explaining your story and more time managing everyday life.

title: Shipyard
description_en: MCP for Claude, Cursor and Codex to Automate Integrations. Built for the vibecoding era, where anyone can build an app in a night and the slow part is everything around it. Shipyard is a local CLI and MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Connect your accounts once, then every new product gets its domain, DNS, hosting, database, email and payments set up automatically in about an hour. Your AI gets a build prompt for the exact stack. Ship more ideas, faster. Your keys never leave your computer.

title: Baby's Day In
description_en: Turn two phones into a baby monitor. Not another baby cam. An AI baby monitor that works on any spare phone: it hears the cry, tells you, and starts the lullaby itself. No hardware to buy. Free on iPhone and Android.

title: aiteam.space
description_en: An AI team where every agent has its own computer. aiteam.space gives each AI teammate, a Son, its own computer. It runs real Claude Code sessions on your own subscription, builds and deploys websites, makes videos, joins your Google Meet calls and handles daily posts. You manage the whole team on a visual org chart, from Claude, ChatGPT, Telegram or Discord. Your first Son is free forever.

title: Publicit
description_en: Omnichannel ad infrastructure for marketers and AI agents. Publicit is self-serve infrastructure to buy advertising across connected TV, street screens and mobile from one API. Choose audience and budget, upload your creative, and our real-time bidder buys the spaces on every channel, with delivery measured hour by hour. Each space shows its price before you buy. Sign-up is free. Built on OpenRTB, with a native MCP server to run campaigns from Claude or ChatGPT.

title: Nova by Vybe
description_en: Nova audits your website free, then fixes what it finds. Vybe's Nova is a free AI agent that audits your website on SEO, speed, conversion, accessibility, and security, then tells you what to fix first. You get a full report in minutes, with before/after mockups and competitor benchmarks. Want the fixes actually done? Nova runs on Vybe, so you can hand her the keys and let her apply the recommendations herself.

title: AI Gateway
description_en: Manage your company's AI from one place. AI Gateway puts your self-hosted models and providers like OpenAI, Groq and Together behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It runs on your own servers. Your GPUs take the traffic first, vendors step in when needed, and you decide who uses what.

title: Prompt Puncher
description_en:
The AI CEO Fighting Game. Prompt Puncher is a free browser fighting game where AI CEOs throw hands. Fight as Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and more. No downloads or signups required.
